$comment: Single source of truth for COMMANDS.md, the Command Studio, the terminal guide, and validation. Edit here, then run npm run build.

surface.name: VS Code Chat view - Local harness
surface.howTo: In the Chat view, set the Session Target to Local. Prompt files and most commands in this lab run only with Local.

mechanisms.title: Plan
mechanisms.smell: Code arrives before anyone agreed what done means. Assumptions stay silent.

mechanisms.title: Ground
mechanisms.tagline: Anchor every claim in repo truth.
mechanisms.smell: Invented helpers, guessed config keys, and packages nobody checked.

mechanisms.title: Verify
mechanisms.smell: "All tests pass" with no command output, tests that cannot fail, and symptom patches.

mechanisms.title: Contain
mechanisms.smell: A one-line fix rewrites five files, changes a public API, or edits frozen code.

mechanisms.title: Context
mechanisms.smell: Long chats drift, stale decisions leak into new work, and nobody can resume.

mechanisms.title: Diagnose and productivity
mechanisms.tagline: Know what the agent saw and can do.
mechanisms.smell: Guessing why a prompt, tool, or customization did not load.

read-only.meaning: Reads and searches only. Cannot edit files or run commands.

runs-commands.meaning: Runs terminal commands (each still needs your approval). Cannot edit files.

writes-artifact.meaning: Writes one named Markdown artifact. Instructed not to touch code.

edits-code.meaning: Edits code and runs tests. Keep approvals on.

builtIns.name: plan
builtIns.purpose: Research and propose an implementation plan.
builtIns.antiSlop: Puts a reviewable plan in front of you before any edit, while wrong assumptions are still cheap to fix.
builtIns.usage: /plan add expiry checks to discount codes; list open questions first

builtIns.name: explain
builtIns.purpose: Explain code.
builtIns.antiSlop: Builds an accurate picture of existing behavior before you ask for a change.

builtIns.name: fix
builtIns.purpose: Suggest a fix for a problem in your code.
builtIns.antiSlop: Aims the agent at one concrete problem instead of an open-ended rewrite. Follow it with /verify.

builtIns.name: tests
builtIns.purpose: Generate tests.
builtIns.antiSlop: Gets tests written early. Review every assertion: a test that cannot fail proves nothing.

builtIns.name: setupTests
builtIns.purpose: Get help choosing and setting up a test framework (experimental).
builtIns.antiSlop: A repo without a test runner cannot produce evidence. Fix that first.

builtIns.name: doc
builtIns.purpose: Generate documentation comments from editor inline chat.
builtIns.antiSlop: Keeps docs next to the code they describe. Delete comments that only narrate the code.
builtIns.usage: /doc (in editor inline chat, with a function selected)

builtIns.name: new
builtIns.purpose: Scaffold a workspace or file.
builtIns.antiSlop: Starts from a known template instead of a hand-rolled project layout.

builtIns.name: newNotebook
builtIns.purpose: Scaffold a Jupyter notebook.
builtIns.antiSlop: Gives exploratory work a separate home, away from production code.

builtIns.name: compact
builtIns.purpose: Compact conversation context.
builtIns.antiSlop: Summarizes earlier turns so stale detail stops crowding out the current task.

builtIns.name: fork
builtIns.purpose: Fork the conversation with its history.
builtIns.antiSlop: Lets you try a risky alternative in a copy so the main thread stays clean.
builtIns.availability: Local. /fork <title> and /fork prompt <prompt> need an Agent Host session.

builtIns.name: clear
builtIns.purpose: Start a new chat and archive or mark the current chat as done.
builtIns.antiSlop: Resets context between tasks. Pair it with /handoff so nothing important is lost.

builtIns.name: rename
builtIns.purpose: Rename a local chat.
builtIns.antiSlop: Name sessions by task so you resume the right context instead of a random thread.

builtIns.name: help
builtIns.purpose: List commands and agents in a local Ask chat.
builtIns.antiSlop: Shows what actually exists in this session instead of guessing.

builtIns.name: models
builtIns.purpose: Open the model picker.
builtIns.antiSlop: Makes the model choice explicit and repeatable.

builtIns.name: tools
builtIns.purpose: Configure tools for a local chat.
builtIns.antiSlop: Turn off tools a task does not need, so the agent cannot wander into the terminal or the web.

builtIns.name: init
builtIns.purpose: Generate or update workspace instructions in a local agent session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Records real build, test, and layout conventions so every session starts grounded.

builtIns.name: instructions
builtIns.purpose: Configure instruction files.
builtIns.antiSlop: Shows which standing rules the agent receives, so you can fix stale ones.

builtIns.name: create-instructions
builtIns.purpose: Generate an instructions file in a local agent session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Turns a correction you keep repeating into a rule the agent always sees.
builtIns.usage: /create-instructions money is integer cents; never use floats

builtIns.name: agents
builtIns.purpose: Configure custom agents.
builtIns.antiSlop: Shows which agent personas exist and what tools they hold.

builtIns.name: skills
builtIns.purpose: Configure agent skills.
builtIns.antiSlop: Confirms which skills can load. See the sibling skills lab.

builtIns.name: prompts
builtIns.purpose: Configure prompt files.
builtIns.antiSlop: Confirms which prompt files (custom /commands) were discovered and where they come from.

builtIns.name: hooks
builtIns.purpose: Configure hooks.
builtIns.antiSlop: Hooks enforce rules deterministically, which a prompt alone cannot.

builtIns.name: create-agent
builtIns.purpose: Generate a custom agent in a local agent session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Packages a role with a narrow tool list.

builtIns.name: create-skill
builtIns.purpose: Generate an agent skill in a local agent session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Captures a workflow the agent can load on demand.

builtIns.name: create-prompt
builtIns.purpose: Generate a prompt file in a local agent session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Turns a good prompt you keep retyping into a reusable /command.
builtIns.usage: /create-prompt review a diff for swallowed errors

builtIns.name: create-hook
builtIns.purpose: Generate a hook in a local agent session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Adds a deterministic guardrail, such as running the tests after every edit.
builtIns.usage: /create-hook run npm test after file edits

builtIns.name: troubleshoot
builtIns.purpose: Analyze agent debug logs in a local or Copilot CLI session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Explains why a prompt file, tool, or instruction did not apply, using the logs instead of guesses.
builtIns.usage: /troubleshoot why did /verify not run the terminal tool?

builtIns.name: debug
builtIns.purpose: Open the Chat Debug view.
builtIns.antiSlop: Shows the exact prompt, context, and tool calls the model received.

builtIns.name: disableAutoApprove
builtIns.purpose: Restore the default permission level.
builtIns.antiSlop: Puts every edit and terminal command back behind your approval.

builtIns.name: autoApprove
builtIns.purpose: Bypass tool approvals for the current session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Listed so you can recognize it. It removes a safety checkpoint, so use it only in a disposable, sandboxed workspace.

builtIns.name: sandbox
builtIns.purpose: /sandbox policy inspects the effective sandbox policy for a Copilot session.
builtIns.antiSlop: Shows what a sandboxed session may touch. Not available with Local.

custom.name: clarify
custom.evidence: At most 5 questions, each with a reason and a proposed default, plus an assumptions table. No code.

custom.name: spec
custom.evidence: Goal, non-goals, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, edge cases, and real verification commands. Undecided items marked OPEN.

custom.name: ground
custom.slop: Invented helpers, config keys, and APIs.
custom.evidence: A Need / Status / Evidence table with file:line for every EXISTS or SIMILAR row.

custom.name: deps-check
custom.slop: Hallucinated packages, invented API members, and trivial dependencies.
custom.evidence: An Import / Kind / API / Verdict table. Anything unverifiable is marked UNVERIFIED. Nothing is installed.

custom.name: deslop
custom.slop: Swallowed errors, fake tests, duplicate helpers, debug prints, and narrating comments.
custom.evidence: A findings table with file:line, pattern, why it matters, and the smallest fix. No edits.

custom.name: verify
custom.slop: "Should work" and "all tests pass" with no evidence.
custom.evidence: Command, exit code, and observed result for every check, then claims vs evidence, then VERIFIED or NOT VERIFIED.

custom.name: root-cause
custom.slop: Special-casing the reported input instead of fixing the defect.
custom.evidence: A reproduction, at most 3 hypotheses, the confirmed cause, and a proposed fix plus regression tests. No edits.

custom.name: fail-paths
custom.evidence: An edge-case table, new tests, and the observed test run. Assertions are never weakened.

custom.name: scope
custom.evidence: A SCOPE.md of at most 40 lines: allowed changes, forbidden paths, frozen API, done-when, and rollback.

custom.name: simplify
custom.evidence: Tests green before and after, with a list of each removal and why behavior is unchanged.

custom.name: pre-commit
custom.slop: Debug output, stubs, secrets, and skipped tests reaching a commit.
custom.evidence: A checklist with evidence per line, then READY or NOT READY. Nothing is edited or committed.

custom.name: handoff
custom.slop: Context rot and lost decisions between sessions.
custom.evidence: A HANDOFF.md of at most 60 lines whose every path exists. Missing evidence says "not run".

copilotApp.note: The GitHub Copilot app has its own slash commands, separate from VS Code. These are the anti-slop ones. This lab does not exercise them.

commands.name: security-review
commands.purpose: Runs a security-focused review of current diffs.

commands.name: rubber-duck
commands.purpose: Asks a different model to critique your approach.

commands.name: spar
commands.purpose: Challenges your approach with adversarial reasoning.

commands.name: research
commands.purpose: Runs a research workflow and produces a cited report.

commands.name: compact
commands.purpose: Summarizes earlier conversation to reduce token pressure.

commands.name: fork
commands.purpose: Forks the session at the latest turn.

commands.name: reset-allowed-tools
commands.purpose: Clears session tool approvals and turns auto-approval off.

commands.name: sandbox on
commands.purpose: Enables local sandboxing for the session.

commands.name: chronicle improve
commands.purpose: Suggests improvements to your instructions file.
